subject.title: [Feature]: Could a ollama simulation billing setting be added to assess the cost of expenses

question: Should explicitly configured per-model costs be honored for Ollama as hypothetical estimates despite the provider's current zero-cost policy?
rationale: The shared pricing schema can represent the request, but changing Ollama's intentional behavior and defining estimate labeling require maintainer product intent.

options.title: Honor Explicit Costs
options.body: Keep discovered Ollama models at zero while preserving user-supplied per-model costs and labeling their output as estimated.

options.title: Keep Zero-Only Policy
options.body: Continue reporting every Ollama model as zero and leave infrastructure-expense accounting to external tooling.

options.title: Add Simulation Mode
options.body: Create a separate Ollama simulation setting and reporting mode, accepting another configuration and UX surface.

recommendation.title: Honor Explicit Costs
recommendation.body: Keep discovered Ollama models at zero while preserving user-supplied per-model costs and labeling their output as estimated.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most strongly connects this person to Ollama provider policy, configuration, and runtime behavior.
